name: NUS Business School, National University of Singapore

program.length_note: Full time: 12 to 17 months; starts every August (homepage)

tuition_total.note: S$91,700 before GST; S$99,953 inclusive of GST (same for full-time and part-time). Full-time schedule: S$10,900 on acceptance, then S$44,526.50 in each of semesters 1 and 2. Live page blocked by Incapsula; read from the Wayback Machine capture of the official page dated 2025-12-18 (http://web.archive.org/web/20251218072428/https://mba.nus.edu.sg/admissions-and-funding/).

scholarship.note: Merit awards for full-time candidates fund 20% or more of tuition depending on award (no separate application). Named: Dhanabalan Scholarship up to S$20,000 (SG citizens/PR, need); Derwin Pereira MBA Scholarship S$25,000 (SG/SEA, need); Hinrich Foundation awards up to US$25,000 (matched corporate funding); NUS alumni grant S$15,000; other Singapore university alumni grant S$8,000; ASEAN tuition fee assistance S$5,000; 10% corporate sponsorship reduction; ADB-JSP and LPDP external full scholarships. Read from Wayback capture dated 2025-12-18.
